description: This file implements the logic for cookie deletion filtering, including domain matching and cookie property checks, within the Chromium project.

classes.name: CookieDeletionInfo
classes.description: Represents criteria for deleting cookies, including time range, domain, name, value, URL, and cookie properties.

classes.name: CookieDeletionInfo::TimeRange
classes.description: Defines a time interval with start and end times, used to filter cookies based on creation date.

methods.name: DomainMatchesDomains
methods.description: Checks if the cookie's effective domain matches any domain in a set of match domains.

methods.name: CookieDeletionInfo::TimeRange::TimeRange
methods.description: Constructs a time range with optional start and end times.

methods.name: CookieDeletionInfo::TimeRange::Contains
methods.description: Checks if a given time falls within the time range.

methods.name: CookieDeletionInfo::Matches
methods.description: Determines if a cookie matches the deletion criteria based on various properties.
